items.statement: Reinsurance treaties currently cede full multi-year premium; renegotiation at renewal around March
items.quote: So currently, our treaties are in place. And as per treaties, we are ceding the entire premium for, let's say, if it's three-year, five-year, two-year terms. So when those treaties come for renewal, maybe around March, we will negotiate with reinsurers.
